card.name: Start of split drug names in lists
card.fires_on: The first piece of a drug name that is split into several pieces, such as Dar, ver, ir, dan or Im. It appears in drug interaction lists or at the start of a sentence about the drug.

modes.label: Name in interaction list
modes.description: First piece of a drug name inside a comma-separated list of interacting drugs.

modes.label: Name as sentence subject
modes.description: First piece of a new drug name that starts a sentence or is the subject of a clause.
modes.example: Mechanism and Clinical Effect<< Dar>>axonrasib is a CYP3

card.writes: It pushes the model toward the middle of the drug name, such as -ycin or -ioni endings, rather than other word starts.
card.plain: It marks the opening syllable of a drug name that the model reads in several pieces, mostly in lists of interacting drugs.
